description: This Java source file defines a test class ExportSchema used to generate a SQL schema script from JPA entity classes. It leverages Hibernate and Spring Framework to configure persistence and perform schema export during testing.

classes.name: ExportSchema
classes.description: Test class that generates SQL schema scripts from annotated POJOs using Hibernate and Spring.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates a SQL script file with create tables, indexes, and foreign keys based on JPA entities; annotated as a JUnit test and ignored during normal test runs.
